title: Nashville Game House Retreat Sleeps 14 w Firepit
description:
Plenty of space & fun for the whole group! Two cozy living spaces, 4bdr/3 full bath, two kitchens/kitchenette, washer/dryer, deck, & another game room in the outbuilding!  Foosball, arcade games, darts, music jam corner, toys, firepit, grill–entertainment for all ages. The music corner has a weighted keyboard, guitar, mics, karaoke machine & speakers. Ample parking in front & back. Space for multiple vehicles, boat, RV, & trailer. Pack n’ play & highchair for the little ones. Great location!

The space
24 minutes to Broadway
23 minutes to Nashville International Airport

Renovated 2 story home with 2 living rooms, 2 kitchens/kitchenette, 2 dining spaces, outdoor grill with dining outside as well

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire property
